Steve Do
Cybersecurity & GRC Analyst - Passionate about Cybersecurity

Who Am I?

Hi, I’m Steve! I’m a cybersecurity professional with hands-on experience across security operations, incident response, and risk management. I’ve supported activities such as digital forensics, application security, and offensive security, helping organizations detect, respond to, and mitigate security threats.

My background includes working with security tools and frameworks to improve visibility, strengthen controls, and support day-to-day security operations

In addition, I have experience in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), where I’ve contributed to policy development, risk assessments, and compliance efforts aligned with industry standards. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve security maturity.

I’m motivated by continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging threats in an evolving cybersecurity landscape.

When I’m not exploring new tools or learning more about cybersecurity, you’ll probably find me building mechanical keyboards, experimenting with new tech, or watching Formula 1.
